novel_features.name: Redeem-vs-cash checker
novel_features.description: Tells you whether to use points or pay cash for a specific booking, using TPG's valuation as the baseline.
novel_features.rationale: Compares one redemption's cents-per-point against the locally mirrored TPG valuation to give a buy/redeem verdict for YOUR numbers, which no TPG page does.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to answer 'points or cash?' for a concrete fare or rate instead of eyeballing a valuation table.

novel_features.name: Points value calculator
novel_features.description: Converts a points/miles balance into an estimated dollar value using TPG's monthly valuation.
novel_features.rationale: Applies the mirrored valuation rate to an arbitrary balance instantly; the site only publishes the rate, not the math for your amount.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to turn a balance into dollars in one call.

novel_features.name: Multi-program portfolio value
novel_features.description: Values many balances across different programs at once from stdin or a file and totals them.
novel_features.rationale: Joins arbitrary balances against the local valuations table in one pass; TPG has no portfolio view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to get a single dollar total across every loyalty currency you hold.

novel_features.name: Card side-by-side compare
novel_features.description: Compares two or more credit cards across annual fee, APRs, welcome bonus, and rewards.
novel_features.rationale: Local join across mirrored card records; TPG has no multi-card comparison table.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to line up two cards' real terms without opening two tabs.

novel_features.name: Valuation drift over time
novel_features.description: Shows how a program's cents-per-point value changed month over month.
novel_features.rationale: Requires historical monthly valuation snapshots in SQLite; a single live page cannot show the trend.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to see whether a currency is being devalued over time.

novel_features.name: Recent publishing window
novel_features.description: Lists everything TPG published in the last N hours or days across all categories.
novel_features.rationale: Time-windowed aggregation over synced articles; a single feed page cannot span an arbitrary window across categories.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to catch up on new deals and news since you last checked.

narrative.headline: The first CLI and local database for The Points Guy: search every article, look up any card's real terms, and turn points valuations into answers you can script.
narrative.value_prop: The Points Guy is the reference for points valuations and credit-card terms, but that data is buried in long articles and JS-rendered pages. This CLI mirrors TPG's valuations, card database, and content into a local SQLite store so you can search (live Algolia or offline FTS), value a balance with 'worth', decide points-vs-cash with 'redeem-check', and compare cards with 'cards compare' — all agent-native with --json and --select.

quickstart.comment: Health check: confirms the site is reachable and search credentials can be discovered; needs no key.
Live full-text search over TPG content.
Look up a program's cents-per-point value.
Mirror articles, cards, and valuations into the local store for offline + transcendence commands.

troubleshoots.fix: Run 'thepointsguy-pp-cli doctor' to re-discover the public Algolia app id and search key from the site bundle; they rotate with deploys.
Run 'thepointsguy-pp-cli sync' first to populate the local valuations and card tables.

troubleshoots.symptom: a card slug is not found
troubleshoots.fix: Run 'thepointsguy-pp-cli cards list' to see valid slugs from the card sitemap.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent or script needs The Points Guy's points valuations, credit-card terms, or article content as structured data: valuing a balance, deciding points vs cash for a booking, comparing cards, or pulling the latest travel-rewards news. It is read-only and needs no account.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to apply for a credit card or access affiliate/apply links.
Do not use it to track your personal loyalty account balances automatically (use AwardWallet); it works from balances you supply.
Do not treat its valuations as offers from card issuers; they are TPG editorial estimates.
